one_liner: Hands-on mechanic repairing and maintaining U.S. Capitol Police fleet vehicles and installing police emergency equipment like lights, sirens and radios.
fit_summary: This skilled trades job requires a year of hands-on automotive repair and current ASE certifications in five areas, with no education substitute. Daniel's resume has none of these, so skip it and look at USCP roles in administration, logistics or emergency preparedness.
eligibility: Open to the public; U.S. citizenship required, no federal status needed.
One year (52 weeks) of specialized automotive repair experience equivalent to CP-06/GS-08 (overhauling components, brake/engine/valve adjustments, diagnostics, HVAC servicing).

Current ASE certifications in all five areas (Suspension and Steering, Brakes, Electrical/Electronic Systems, Heating and Air Conditioning, Engine Performance), and copies must be attached or the application is incomplete.
No education substitution for experience at this grade.
Must pass a full field background investigation and a one-year probationary period.
